import sympy as sp
# circle 1 centre (0,0) radius 5; P and R diametrically opposite; Q another point on circle 1
P=sp.Point(3,4); R=sp.Point(-3,-4); Q=sp.Point(5,0)
v1=P-Q; v2=R-Q
ang=sp.deg(sp.acos(v1.dot(v2)/(v1.distance(sp.Point(0,0))*v2.distance(sp.Point(0,0)))))
opts={'A':45,'B':0,'C':90,'D':60}
assert sp.simplify(ang-opts['C'])==0

import sympy as sp
k=sp.symbols('k')
bad=sp.solve(4*(k+4)-6*6,k)  # determinant zero
assert bad==[5]
# option A: k != 5 exactly matches the unique-solution set
opts={'A':('ne',5),'B':('ne',7),'C':('eq',5),'D':('eq',7)}
def unique(kv): return 4*(kv+4)-36!=0
def matches(o):
    t,v=o
    return all((kv!=v if t=='ne' else kv==v)==unique(kv) for kv in range(-20,21))
fits=[kk for kk,o in opts.items() if matches(o)]
assert fits==['A']
